stock.description: FAR International Holdings Group Co. Ltd. specializes in providing an array of services, including delivery and extensive supply chain solutions, primarily operating through its various subsidiary companies. The firm conducts its business activities across the distinct geographical segments of Mainland China and Hong Kong. Established on November 24, 2022, its corporate headquarters are situated in Hangzhou City, China.
